scripts.format: prettier --write . && sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --project backend ruff format backend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --project backend ruff format --check backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --directory backend pytest -q
scripts.check:backend: sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --directory backend ruff check . && sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --directory backend pyright && sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --directory backend pytest -q
scripts.check: npm run check -w frontend && npm run check:backend && npm run deploy:dry-run
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build -w frontend && sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --directory backend pywrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build -w frontend && sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --directory backend pywrangler deploy

backend/**/*.py: sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --project backend ruff check --fix
sh scripts/with-uv.sh run --project backend ruff format
